invalid_query: The search filters are not valid.
invalid_amount: The amount must be zero or greater with up to two decimals.
empty_update: There are no changes to save.
not_draft: This purchase is already confirmed or canceled: its lines and amounts cannot be edited.
not_confirmed: This purchase is not confirmed yet.
product_not_found: One of the products in the purchase does not exist.
presentation_invalid: That presentation does not belong to that product or is deactivated.
lot_not_tracked: {field}: this product isn't tracked by lot. Remove the lot and expiry, or turn on lot tracking on its catalog card.
date_in_future: {field}: the date can't be after today. A purchase is a document that already arrived.
lot_expiry_mismatch: {field}: lot “{lotCode}” already exists with a different expiry date. The expiry belongs to the lot: leave it empty and it fills in, or fix the lot code.
warehouse_required: You have no assigned warehouse: choose where the purchase goes in.
needs_lines: Add at least one product before confirming the purchase.
line_needs_cost: Enter the cost for {field}: it is the one that will stay in the catalog.
entry_already_confirmed: The inventory entry for this purchase is already confirmed: the goods came in. To correct it, record an exit.
cancel_reason_required: Write the reason for the cancellation (at least 3 characters).
draft_has_no_document: A draft purchase has no document yet: confirm it first.
order_not_found: The purchase order does not exist.
receipt_foreign: One of those receipts does not belong to this order.
receipt_not_confirmed: Only a confirmed receipt can be invoiced.
receipt_invoiced: That receipt is already invoiced in another purchase: cancel that purchase first.
order_line_foreign: {field}: that line does not belong to this purchase's order.
